(1) config PRESENT+UNLOADABLE (module body throws on a missing env var, the issue's own AUTH_SECRET shape): exit 0/0/0/0 BEFORE -> 1/1/1/1 AFTER; stdout byte-identical both modes; stderr gains exactly one line: '[migrate] X Host config

/objectstack.config.ts exists but could not be loaded: Missing required environment variable OS_12953_AUTH_SECRET. This run therefore covered ONLY the objects the data stack registered - a fraction of what this deployment serves - so its result is UNMEASURED, not \"in sync\", and it is reported as a FAILURE rather than as success. Remedy: supply the environment this config needs (the failure named above says which), or fix the config, then re-run.' The --json payload on this path is BYTE-IDENTICAL before/after (composition.hostConfigLoaded:false, composition.hostConfig, managedTables:9) - only the exit status changed. (2) config ABSENT: 0/0/0/0 -> 0/0/0/0, stdout AND stderr byte-identical on all four invocations (managedTables:5, no composition block). (3) config PRESENT+LOADABLE: 0/0/0/0 -> 0/0/0/0, stdout AND stderr byte-identical on all four (managedTables:10, hostConfigLoaded:true). INSTRUMENTATION POSITIVE CONTROL for the 'hostConfigLoaded still present' claim: the same grep probe returns 0 matches on the absent direction, so it genuinely fails when the field is gone. ABLATION (process.exitCode = 1 -> 0 in refuseWhenHostConfigUnloadable): mutation proven on disk BEFORE any reading - anchor 'process.exitCode = 1;' count 1->0, injected marker count 1, blob hash 02c2d131->ba5fd538; restored via `git checkout HEAD --` on an ABSOLUTE path under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap and proven restored by blob-hash equality with the HEAD blob (02c2d131 == 02c2d131) + empty `git diff HEAD` + marker count back to 0 - not by the trap's exit code. Result: exactly 2 of 9 e2e cases RED (the two direction-1 exit-status pins for plan and apply); the other 7 GREEN, including BOTH of direction 2 and BOTH of direction 3 - the asymmetry the ruling's scope demands. NO REBUILD LEG NEEDED AND NONE SKIPPED: packages/cli/dist does not exist in this tree and the suite drives bin/run-dev.js (src through tsx), so src IS the artifact under test. PINS: new packages/cli/test/migrate-unloadable-host-config-exit.e2e.test.ts (9 cases, real child process, all three directions) + unit pins on describeUnloadableHostConfig in packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.test.ts (all three directions + message-less throw). Residual risk closed by hand: the new e2e file lands in packages/cli/test/**, which the @objectstack/cli TEST_DEBT ratchet freezes at 146 errors; tsc --listFiles proved that file is absent from the package's typecheck program (tsconfig include: [\"src\"] - a known, ledgered shape), and type-checking it standalone under the package's compiler options gave ZERO errors, with a deliberately broken copy as the positive control that the probe can fail.", "check:i18n, check:i18n-coverage, check:dual-build-cjs-loads - all three printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET (they read built output; packages/cli/dist absent). Each states in its own words that nothing was measured. Attempting the CLI build to satisfy check:i18n hit os-verify-lock exit 99 (queue-timeout, 540s, holder was another agent running the full @objectstack/cli test suite) - DECLARED NARROWING, left to CI. Low risk: the change adds no i18n-keyed message and no declared label; the new stderr line is a plain console.error, the same shape as the sibling warning beside it.", "scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs - exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no valid GitHub credential in this container; it states 'no reading at all'.", "check-test-completeness - a CI harness that takes a turbo test log as an argument; invoked bare it prints usage. A mis-invocation, not a failed measurement.", "The 14 remaining packages/cli test files that reach the changed modules (of 23 enumerated by grep -rln) were NOT run locally - DECLARED NARROWING. CI runs the farm regardless." ], "open_questions": [ { "question": "The ruling fixes the exit STATUS for `os migrate apply`, but does not say whether apply should also decline to PERFORM the DDL on the unloadable-config path. Today (and in this PR) apply still flushes the deferred schema work and applies drift over the reduced set, then exits non-zero.", "options": [ "A - leave as shipped: apply does exactly what it did before and reports non-zero. Minimal, literally the ruling, nothing regresses relative to today (the same DDL ran before, silently, with exit 0).", "B - refuse before mutating: apply exits non-zero without touching the database.
